courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 振動碎石樁施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「飽和土有效應力」與「改善抗力增幅」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；振動碎石樁施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective stress in saturated soil" and "Treatment resistance gain" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Vibro-replacement stone columns must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求；振動碎石樁施工則以連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage; Vibro-replacement stone columns centres on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「飽和土有效應力」與「方格置換面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到振動碎石樁施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「排水時間尺度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective stress in saturated soil” and “Square grid replacement area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Vibro-replacement stone columns, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drainage time scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道耐震接頭設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「飽和土有效應力」與「改善抗力增幅」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道耐震接頭設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective stress in saturated soil" and "Treatment resistance gain" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic tunnel-joint design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求；隧道耐震接頭設計則以以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage; Seismic tunnel-joint design centres on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「飽和土有效應力」與「波傳軸向應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道耐震接頭設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「斷層變形帶需求」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective stress in saturated soil” and “Wave induced axial strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic tunnel-joint design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fault deformation band demand", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 液化地盤評估與改善
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求的背景。灣區捷運完成系統耐震脆弱度研究（2002）。美國聯邦公路管理局列出岩土耐震參考手冊（2011）。美國聯邦公路管理局列出地盤改良參考手冊（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. BART completes a system seismic vulnerability study (2002). FHWA lists its seismic geotechnical reference manual (2011). FHWA lists its ground modification reference manual (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
